test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following dance forms is NOT a classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Burrakatha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Classical dance**

 
 
• Classical dances are performed by professional or highly trained dancers who have studied their form for many years.
 
• There are **eight classical Dances** in India.
 
• Classical dance expresses a story or theme and this form of art lies in the religious Hindu music theatre styles. It represents the culture.
 
• They are
 
 
• **Kathak from North India, **
 
• **Sattriya of Assam, **
 
• **Bharatnatyam of Tamil Nadu,**
 
• **Kuchipudi of Andhra Pradesh****,**
 
• **Kathakali and Mohiniaattam of Kerala,**
 
• **Manipuri of Northeast India, and **
 
• **Odissi of Odisha.**
 
 
 
• It is the right way to connect with your feelings, coordinate and move the movement skills and build strength and stability in your body.
 
 
 
• **Hence Burrakatha is not classical dance. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Burrakatha is a highly dramatic form of the ballad of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Burra Katha or Burrakatha is a Telugu art of oral storytelling.
 
• The term Burra refers to tambura and Katha means a story.
 
• It is performed in the Coastal Andhra region, Rayalaseema and Telangana.
